title: [Perf] Sample in log space in TopKTopPSampler.forward_native, skipping the full-vocab softmax

## Purpose

`TopKTopPSampler.forward_native` computes `probs = logits.softmax(-1)` only to feed the exponential-noise Gumbel trick, `argmax(probs / q)`. The MRV2 sampler's Triton gumbel kernel already samples straight from logits; this brings the V1 sampler in line (still the live path for hybrid/GDN models and any non-MRV2 deployment). Merged precedent for the same idea on another path: #32852 (skip softmax for all-greedy rejection sampling).

title: Decode optimizations for NVIDIA confidential computing
body:
## Background

Confidential Computing (CC) is a feature of NVIDIA GPUs (Hopper and later) that protects workloads running in a confidential VM from infrastructure operators. It implements a range of security features on the GPU, including encrypted data transfers over PCIe and between GPUs. CC is designed to require no code changes for existing applications, albeit often at a performance penalty.

Running vLLM under CC, we measured a significant degradation in both prefill and decode performance relative to non-CC operation.
